questions.text: Which word means 'I' or 'me'? Choose the correct word.

feedback: 你 (nǐ) means 'you'
我们 (wǒmen) means 'we'

questions.solution: 我 (wǒ) = I, me; 你 (nǐ) = you; 他 (tā) = he; 我们 (wǒmen) = we
questions.hint: It is one character, and adding 们 (men) to it makes 'we'

questions.text: What does 他们 (tāmen) mean? Choose the correct translation.
questions.solution: 他 (tā) = he; adding 们 (men) makes it plural: 他们 (tāmen) = they
questions.hint: 们 (men) makes a pronoun plural

questions.text: What does 你 (nǐ) mean? Answer in English.
questions.solution: 你 (nǐ) = you, as in 你好 (nǐ hǎo), hello
questions.hint: It is in the greeting 你好 (nǐ hǎo)

questions.text: Which particle goes at the end of a sentence to make a yes/no question?

feedback: 了 (le) shows a completed action or change
呢 (ne) asks 'and you?' or 'what about…?'

questions.solution: 吗 (ma) at the end makes a yes/no question: 你好吗 (nǐ hǎo ma)? = How are you?
questions.hint: Think of the question 你好___? (How are you?)

questions.text: Complete: 我___是学生 (Wǒ ___ shì xuésheng) = I am not a student.

feedback: 没 (méi) negates 有 (yǒu) and past actions, not 是 (shì)
很 (hěn) means 'very'
也 (yě) means 'also'

questions.solution: 不 (bù) negates 是 (shì): 我不是学生 = I am not a student
questions.hint: Which word means 'not' and can go before 是 (shì)?

questions.text: Give the pinyin for the Chinese greeting that means 'hello' (two syllables).
questions.solution: 你好 (nǐ hǎo) = hello; 您好 (nín hǎo) is the polite form
questions.hint: It starts with the word for 'you'

questions.text: Which particle shows a completed action? 我买___一本书 (Wǒ mǎi ___ yì běn shū) = I bought a book.

feedback: 吗 (ma) makes a question

questions.solution: 了 (le) after a verb shows a completed action: 我买了一本书 = I bought a book
questions.hint: The action is finished

questions.text: What does 很 (hěn) mean in 她很高 (tā hěn gāo)?
questions.solution: 很 (hěn) = very: 她很高 = she is (very) tall
questions.hint: It comes before an adjective to make it stronger

questions.text: What does 也 (yě) mean? Answer in English.
questions.solution: 也 (yě) = also, too: 我也是学生 (wǒ yě shì xuésheng) = I am also a student
questions.hint: It comes before the verb, as in 我___是学生 (wǒ ___ shì xuésheng)

questions.text: Which measure word goes with 书 (shū, book)? 一___书 (yì ___ shū)

feedback: 只 (zhī) is used for many animals
张 (zhāng) is used for flat things like paper and tables
个 (gè) is the general measure word, but books use their own one

questions.solution: 本 (běn) is the measure word for books: 一本书 (yì běn shū) = one book
questions.hint: It is the measure word for bound things like books and magazines

questions.text: Which sentence means 'I don't have an older brother'?

options: 我不有哥哥 (Wǒ bù yǒu gēge)
feedback: 有 (yǒu) is never negated with 不 (bù)

questions.solution: 有 (yǒu) is always negated with 没 (méi): 我没有哥哥
questions.hint: 有 (yǒu) uses a special negative word

questions.text: Give the pinyin of the word for 'not' that is used to negate 有 (yǒu, to have).
questions.solution: 没 (méi): 没有 (méiyǒu) = not have
questions.hint: It is not 不 (bù)

questions.text: What does 我明天去北京 (Wǒ míngtiān qù Běijīng) mean?

options: I am going to Beijing tomorrow

questions.solution: 明天 (míngtiān) = tomorrow; 去 (qù) = to go
questions.hint: 明天 (míngtiān) is a time word

questions.text: Which sentence correctly means 'I study in the evening'?
questions.solution: Time words go before the verb: 我晚上学习
questions.hint: In Chinese, the time word comes before the verb

questions.text: What does 昨天 (zuótiān) mean? Answer in English.
questions.solution: 昨天 (zuótiān) = yesterday; 今天 (jīntiān) = today; 明天 (míngtiān) = tomorrow
questions.hint: 天 (tiān) means 'day'

questions.text: Complete: 我___中国人 (Wǒ ___ Zhōngguó rén) = I am Chinese.

feedback: 在 (zài) means 'to be at (a place)'
很 (hěn) goes before adjectives
有 (yǒu) means 'to have'

questions.solution: 是 (shì) = to be (am, is, are) before a noun: 我是中国人
questions.hint: Which word links two nouns, like 'am' in English?

questions.text: What does 我会说中文 (Wǒ huì shuō Zhōngwén) mean?
questions.solution: 会 (huì) = can, know how to; 说 (shuō) = speak
questions.hint: 会 (huì) here is about a skill you have learned

questions.text: In 他在看书 (Tā zài kàn shū), is the action finished or happening now?
questions.solution: 在 (zài) before a verb shows an action in progress: he is reading
questions.hint: 在 (zài) before a verb is like '-ing' in English

questions.text: What does 我去过中国 mean?

options: I don't want to go to China

questions.solution: 过 (guo) after a verb shows experience: I have been to China
questions.hint: 过 after a verb talks about experience

questions.text: Which sentence means 'My older brother is taller than me'?

feedback: This means 'my brother is not as tall as me'
This means 'I am taller than my brother'

questions.solution: A 比 B + adjective = A is more … than B: 我哥哥比我高
questions.hint: The pattern is A 比 B + adjective

questions.text: Give the pinyin for 谢谢.
questions.solution: 谢谢 (xièxie) = thank you
questions.hint: It is what you say when someone gives you a present

questions.text: What does 如果明天下雨，我就不去公园 mean?

options: It rained yesterday, so I didn't go to the park
I go to the park when it rains
If it rains tomorrow, I won't go to the park

questions.solution: 如果 … 就 … = if … then …; 下雨 = rain; 公园 = park
questions.hint: 如果 means 'if'

questions.text: What does 所以 mean in 因为下雨，所以我在家? Answer in English.
questions.solution: 因为 … 所以 … = because … so …: because it is raining, I am at home
questions.hint: 因为 at the start gives the reason; 所以 introduces the result

questions.text: Which sentence means 'I will go to school by bus'?

options: 我会坐公共汽车去学校
我坐公共汽车去了学校
我不坐公共汽车去学校
feedback: 了 shows the trip has already happened

questions.solution: 会 = will; 坐公共汽车 = by bus; 去学校 = go to school
questions.hint: Look for 会, which can show the future

questions.text: Which sentence means 'I have been learning Chinese for two years (and still am)'?

feedback: This means 'I studied Chinese twice'
This means 'I studied Chinese two years ago'
This means 'I am going to study Chinese for two years'

questions.solution: Verb + 了 + duration + object + 了 shows an action that has lasted until now
questions.hint: Look for the sentence with two 了

questions.text: Why is 两, not 二, used in 两个人 ('two people')?

options: 两 is more polite than 二
Before a measure word, 'two' is usually 两
二 is only used for dates

questions.solution: Before a measure word such as 个, 'two' is 两: 两个人
questions.hint: Look at the word that comes after the number

questions.text: In 我把作业做完了, what does 把 do?

options: It makes the sentence a question
It moves the object before the verb

questions.solution: 把 brings the object (作业, homework) before the verb: I finished the homework
questions.hint: Find the object 作业 and look at where it comes in the sentence

questions.text: In 我是坐火车来的, the 是…的 pattern stresses one detail of a past action. Which detail: when, where or how? Answer in English with one word.
questions.solution: 是…的 stresses the detail between them: 坐火车 = by train, so it stresses how I came
questions.hint: Look at the words between 是 and 来的

questions.text: Give the pinyin for 学校 (school).
questions.solution: 学校 (xuéxiào) = school
questions.hint: 学 is the character in 学生 (student)

questions.text: What does 已经 mean in 他已经走了? Answer in English.
questions.solution: 已经 = already: 他已经走了 = he has already left
questions.hint: 已经 often goes with 了 at the end of the sentence

questions.text: What does 妈妈 (māma) mean? Choose the correct translation.
questions.solution: 妈妈 (māma) = mum; 爸爸 (bàba) = dad
questions.hint: It sounds like an English word for a parent

questions.text: Which word means 'dad'?
questions.solution: 爸爸 (bàba) = dad; 妈妈 (māma) = mum; 哥哥 (gēge) = older brother; 弟弟 (dìdi) = younger brother
questions.hint: It sounds like 'papa'

questions.text: What does 朋友 (péngyou) mean? Answer in English.
questions.solution: 朋友 (péngyou) = friend
questions.hint: You spend your free time with this person

questions.text: What does 老师 (lǎoshī) mean? Choose the correct translation.
questions.solution: 老师 (lǎoshī) = teacher; 学生 (xuésheng) = student
questions.hint: This person works in a 学校 (xuéxiào), school, and gives lessons

questions.text: Which word means 'younger sister'?

feedback: 姐姐 (jiějie) is an older sister

questions.solution: 妹妹 (mèimei) = younger sister; 姐姐 (jiějie) = older sister
questions.hint: 姐姐 (jiějie) is the older sister; find the other sister word

questions.text: Give the pinyin for the Chinese word meaning 'student' (two syllables).
questions.solution: 学生 (xuésheng) = student
questions.hint: The first syllable is the same as in 学校 (school)

questions.text: What does 医生 (yīshēng) mean? Choose the correct translation.
questions.solution: 医生 (yīshēng) = doctor; 护士 (hùshi) = nurse
questions.hint: 医 (yī) is the character in 医院 (yīyuàn), hospital

questions.text: What does 高 (gāo) mean when describing a person?
questions.solution: 高 (gāo) = tall; 矮 (ǎi) = short
questions.hint: Its opposite is 矮 (ǎi)

questions.text: What does 哥哥 (gēge) mean? Answer in English.

feedback.younger brother: 弟弟 (dìdi) is a younger brother
feedback.brother: Be precise: 哥哥 (gēge) is specifically an older brother

questions.solution: 哥哥 (gēge) = older brother; 弟弟 (dìdi) = younger brother
questions.hint: There are two words for 'brother' in Chinese, depending on age

questions.text: What does 聪明 (cōngming) mean? Choose the correct translation.
questions.solution: 聪明 (cōngming) = clever; 懒 (lǎn) = lazy; 友好 (yǒuhǎo) = friendly; 害羞 (hàixiū) = shy
questions.hint: A student who gets top marks is often called this

questions.text: What does 学校 (xuéxiào) mean? Answer in English.
questions.solution: 学校 (xuéxiào) = school; 学生 (xuésheng) = student
questions.hint: 学 (xué) means 'to study'

questions.text: Which word means 'to get up'?
questions.solution: 起床 (qǐchuáng) = to get up; 睡觉 (shuìjiào) = to sleep; 吃饭 (chīfàn) = to eat; 上学 (shàngxué) = to go to school
questions.hint: 床 (chuáng) means 'bed'

questions.text: What does 我家有四口人 (Wǒ jiā yǒu sì kǒu rén) mean?

options: There are four people in my family
My home is four kilometres away

questions.solution: 口 (kǒu) is the measure word for family members: four people in my family
questions.hint: 人 (rén) means 'person'

questions.text: What does 我每天七点起床 (Wǒ měitiān qī diǎn qǐchuáng) mean?

options: I get up at seven every day
I go to bed at seven every day
I get up at eleven every day

questions.solution: 每天 (měitiān) = every day; 七点 (qī diǎn) = seven o'clock; 起床 (qǐchuáng) = get up
questions.hint: 起床 (qǐchuáng) contains 床 (chuáng), bed

questions.text: 我姐姐是护士 (Wǒ jiějie shì hùshi). What is the older sister's job? Answer in English.
questions.solution: 护士 (hùshi) = nurse
questions.hint: This person works in a hospital and looks after patients, but is not a doctor

questions.text: What does 我喜欢数学 (Wǒ xǐhuan shùxué) mean?
questions.solution: 喜欢 (xǐhuan) = like; 数学 (shùxué) = maths
questions.hint: 数 (shù) means 'number'

questions.text: 我爸爸很忙 (Wǒ bàba hěn máng). What is Dad like? Answer in English.
questions.solution: 忙 (máng) = busy; 很 (hěn) = very
questions.hint: Someone with lots of work and no free time is this

questions.text: What does 他很友好 (Tā hěn yǒuhǎo) mean?
questions.solution: 友好 (yǒuhǎo) = friendly; 很 (hěn) = very
questions.hint: 友 (yǒu) is the character in 朋友 (péngyou)

questions.text: Read: 我叫小明。我十六岁。我喜欢英语，可是我不喜欢历史。 Which statement is true?
questions.solution: 我喜欢英语 = I like English; 我不喜欢历史 = I don't like history; 十六岁 = 16 years old
questions.hint: 可是 means 'but'

questions.text: Read: 我爸爸是医生，他在医院工作。 Where does the father work?
questions.solution: 医院 = hospital; 在医院工作 = works in a hospital
questions.hint: 医 is in both 医生 (doctor) and 医院

questions.text: Read: 我每天早上跑步，因为跑步对身体好。 What does the person do every morning? Answer in English.
questions.solution: 跑步 = to run, to go running; 对身体好 = good for the body
questions.hint: 跑 contains the 'foot' part 足

questions.text: Read: 以后我想当老师。 What does the person want to do in the future?
questions.solution: 以后 = in the future; 想当老师 = want to be a teacher
questions.hint: 当 here means 'to work as'

questions.text: Read: 我妹妹比我小三岁。 How many years younger than the writer is the younger sister? Answer with a number.
questions.solution: 比我小三岁 = three years younger than me
questions.hint: 岁 means 'years of age'; look at the number before it

questions.text: Read: 我晚上十点睡觉。 What happens at ten in the evening?
questions.solution: 睡觉 = to sleep, go to bed; 晚上十点 = 10 pm
questions.hint: 觉 here is about sleep

questions.text: Read: 我以前不爱运动，但是现在我每个周末都去游泳。 Which statement is accurate?

options: The person now swims every weekend
The person has always loved sport

questions.solution: 以前不爱运动 = didn't like sport before; 现在每个周末都去游泳 = now goes swimming every weekend
questions.hint: Contrast 以前 (before) with 现在 (now)

questions.text: Read: 我的好朋友很幽默，可是有时候有点儿懒。 What is the friend like?

options: Funny but sometimes a bit lazy

questions.solution: 幽默 = humorous, funny; 有时候有点儿懒 = sometimes a bit lazy
questions.hint: 幽默 sounds like the English word 'humour'

questions.text: Read: 我想上大学学习医学，因为我想帮助病人。 Why does the person want to study medicine?

options: To earn a lot of money

questions.solution: 因为我想帮助病人 = because I want to help sick people (patients)
questions.hint: The reason comes after 因为 (because); 病人 are people who are ill

questions.text: Read: 为了身体健康，我少吃糖，多喝水。 What does the person drink more of? Answer in English.

feedback.sugar: 糖 (sugar) is what the person eats less of

questions.solution: 多喝水 = drink more water; 少吃糖 = eat less sugar
questions.hint: 多 means 'more' and 喝 means 'drink'

questions.text: Give the pinyin for 工作 (work, job).
questions.solution: 工作 (gōngzuò) = work, job
questions.hint: The first syllable sounds like the first syllable of 公园 (park)

questions.text: Read: 我周末常常帮妈妈做饭，所以我会做很多中国菜。 Which statement is accurate?

options: The person cooks only on weekdays
The person can cook many Chinese dishes

questions.solution: 常常帮妈妈做饭 = often cooks with Mum; 会做很多中国菜 = can make many Chinese dishes
questions.hint: 会做 means 'can make'

questions.text: What does 茶 (chá) mean? Choose the correct translation.
questions.solution: 茶 (chá) = tea; 咖啡 (kāfēi) = coffee; 水 (shuǐ) = water; 牛奶 (niúnǎi) = milk
questions.hint: It sounds like the English 'char' or 'chai'

questions.text: Which word means cooked 'rice'?
questions.solution: 米饭 (mǐfàn) = cooked rice; 面条 (miàntiáo) = noodles; 饺子 (jiǎozi) = dumplings; 包子 (bāozi) = steamed buns
questions.hint: 米 (mǐ) means 'rice grain'

questions.text: What does 电影 (diànyǐng) mean? Answer in English.
questions.solution: 电影 (diànyǐng) = film; 电影院 (diànyǐngyuàn) = cinema
questions.hint: 电 (diàn) means 'electric' and 影 (yǐng) means 'shadow'

questions.text: What does 足球 (zúqiú) mean? Choose the correct translation.
questions.solution: 足球 (zúqiú) = football (足 = foot, 球 = ball)
questions.hint: 足 (zú) means 'foot' and 球 (qiú) means 'ball'

questions.text: What does 唱歌 (chànggē) mean? Choose the correct translation.
questions.solution: 唱歌 (chànggē) = to sing; 跳舞 (tiàowǔ) = to dance
questions.hint: 歌 (gē) means 'song'

questions.text: Give the pinyin for the Chinese word meaning 'water' (one syllable).
questions.solution: 水 (shuǐ) = water
questions.hint: It starts with sh-

questions.text: What does 饺子 (jiǎozi) mean? Choose the correct translation.
questions.solution: 饺子 (jiǎozi) = dumplings, often eaten at Spring Festival
questions.hint: Families often make them together at Chinese New Year

questions.text: Which phrase means 'to watch TV'?
questions.solution: 看电视 (kàn diànshì) = watch TV; 听音乐 (tīng yīnyuè) = listen to music; 打篮球 (dǎ lánqiú) = play basketball; 上网 (shàngwǎng) = go online
questions.hint: 看 (kàn) means 'to look at, to watch'

questions.text: What does 跳舞 (tiàowǔ) mean? Answer in English.
questions.solution: 跳舞 (tiàowǔ) = to dance
questions.hint: 跳 (tiào) means 'to jump'

questions.text: What does 春节 (Chūnjié) mean? Choose the correct translation.
questions.solution: 春节 (Chūnjié) = Spring Festival (Chinese New Year); 春 (chūn) = spring, 节 (jié) = festival
questions.hint: 春 (chūn) is a season

questions.text: What does 打篮球 (dǎ lánqiú) mean? Answer in English.
questions.solution: 打篮球 (dǎ lánqiú) = play basketball (篮 = basket, 球 = ball)
questions.hint: 篮 (lán) means 'basket' and 球 (qiú) means 'ball'

questions.text: What does 手机 (shǒujī) mean? Choose the correct translation.
questions.solution: 手机 (shǒujī) = mobile phone (手 = hand, 机 = machine)
questions.hint: 手 (shǒu) means 'hand' and 机 (jī) means 'machine'

questions.text: What does 我喜欢看电影 (Wǒ xǐhuan kàn diànyǐng) mean?
questions.solution: 喜欢 (xǐhuan) = like; 看电影 (kàn diànyǐng) = watch films
questions.hint: 电影 (diànyǐng) means 'film'

questions.text: What does 周末我常常打乒乓球 (Zhōumò wǒ chángcháng dǎ pīngpāngqiú) mean?

options: I played table tennis last weekend
At weekends I often play table tennis
At weekends I never play table tennis
I play table tennis every day

questions.solution: 周末 (zhōumò) = weekend; 常常 (chángcháng) = often; 乒乓球 (pīngpāngqiú) = table tennis
questions.hint: 常常 (chángcháng) is a frequency word

questions.text: 我最喜欢的菜是面条 (Wǒ zuì xǐhuan de cài shì miàntiáo). What is the person's favourite dish? Answer in English.
questions.solution: 面条 (miàntiáo) = noodles; 最喜欢的 (zuì xǐhuan de) = favourite
questions.hint: 条 (tiáo) is used for long thin things

questions.text: What do people traditionally eat at the Mid-Autumn Festival (中秋节, Zhōngqiū jié)?

feedback: Zongzi are eaten at the Dragon Boat Festival

questions.solution: People eat 月饼 (yuèbing), mooncakes, and admire the full moon
questions.hint: The festival is held when the moon is full

questions.text: 我每天上网 (Wǒ měitiān shàngwǎng). What does the person do every day? Answer in English.
questions.solution: 上网 (shàngwǎng) = go online; 网 (wǎng) = net
questions.hint: 网 (wǎng) means 'net'

questions.text: What does 我会弹钢琴 (Wǒ huì tán gāngqín) mean?

options: I like listening to the piano
I want to buy a piano

questions.solution: 会 (huì) = can; 弹钢琴 (tán gāngqín) = play the piano
questions.hint: 钢琴 (gāngqín) is a keyboard instrument

questions.text: Read: 春节的时候，我们全家一起吃饭，孩子们收红包。 What do children receive at Spring Festival?
questions.solution: 收红包 = receive red envelopes (红包) with money inside
questions.hint: 红 means 'red' and 包 means 'packet'

questions.text: Read: 我觉得社交媒体很有意思，但是有时候浪费时间。 What is the person's opinion of social media?

options: Interesting but sometimes a waste of time
Boring and a waste of time

questions.solution: 很有意思 = very interesting; 有时候浪费时间 = sometimes wastes time
questions.hint: 有意思 means 'interesting'; 但是 means 'but'

questions.text: Read: 我爸爸喜欢喝咖啡，我妈妈喜欢喝茶。 What does the father like to drink?
questions.solution: 咖啡 = coffee; the mother likes 茶 (tea)
questions.hint: Say 咖啡 (kāfēi) aloud

questions.text: Read: 昨天晚上我和朋友去看了一部很好笑的电影。 What kind of film did they see?
questions.solution: 好笑 = funny; 很 = very
questions.hint: 笑 means 'to laugh'

questions.text: Give the pinyin for 音乐 (music).
questions.solution: 音乐 (yīnyuè) = music
questions.hint: It has two syllables; the first one sounds like 'yin'

questions.text: Read: 我每个星期六都去踢足球。如果下雨，我就在家玩电脑游戏。 What does the person do when it rains?
questions.solution: 如果下雨 = if it rains; 在家玩电脑游戏 = play computer games at home
questions.hint: 如果 means 'if'

questions.text: Read: 端午节的时候，人们吃粽子，看龙舟比赛。 Which festival is described?
questions.solution: 端午节 is the Dragon Boat Festival: people eat 粽子 (zongzi) and watch 龙舟 (dragon boat) races
questions.hint: 龙 means 'dragon' and 舟 means 'boat'

questions.text: Read: 虽然中国菜很好吃，但是我觉得有点儿辣。 Which statement is accurate?

options: The person cannot eat spicy food
The person finds Chinese food tasty but a bit spicy
The person does not like Chinese food at all

questions.solution: 虽然 … 但是 … = although … but …; 好吃 = tasty; 有点儿辣 = a bit spicy
questions.hint: 虽然 … 但是 … introduces a contrast

questions.text: Read: 我以前常常看电视，现在我更喜欢用手机看视频。 What has changed?

options: The person now watches more TV
The person now prefers watching videos on the phone

questions.solution: 以前 = before; 现在更喜欢用手机看视频 = now prefers watching videos on the phone
questions.hint: Contrast 以前 (before) with 现在 (now)

questions.text: Read: 元宵节的晚上，很多人去看灯笼。 What do many people go to see? Answer in English.
questions.solution: 灯笼 = lanterns; 元宵节 is the Lantern Festival
questions.hint: 灯 means 'lamp, light'

questions.text: Give the pinyin for 中国 (China).
questions.solution: 中国 (Zhōngguó) = China, the 'Middle Kingdom'
questions.hint: 中 means 'middle' and starts with zh-

questions.text: Read: 我每天花两个小时玩电子游戏，我妈妈说太多了。 What does the mother think? Answer in English.
questions.solution: 太多了 = too much: Mum thinks two hours a day of video games is too much
questions.hint: 太 means 'too' and 多 means 'many, much'

questions.text: What does 火车 (huǒchē) mean? Choose the correct translation.
questions.solution: 火车 (huǒchē) = train (火 = fire, 车 = vehicle)
questions.hint: 火 (huǒ) means 'fire': think of old steam engines

questions.text: Which word means 'plane'?
questions.solution: 飞机 (fēijī) = plane; 火车 (huǒchē) = train; 汽车 (qìchē) = car; 船 (chuán) = boat
questions.hint: 飞 (fēi) means 'to fly'

questions.text: What does 商店 (shāngdiàn) mean? Answer in English.
questions.solution: 商店 (shāngdiàn) = shop
questions.hint: You buy things there

questions.text: What does 下雨 (xià yǔ) mean? Choose the correct translation.
questions.solution: 下雨 (xià yǔ) = to rain; 下雪 (xià xuě) = to snow
questions.hint: 雨 (yǔ) falls from clouds and makes you wet

questions.text: What does 医院 (yīyuàn) mean? Choose the correct translation.
questions.solution: 医院 (yīyuàn) = hospital; 医生 (yīshēng) = doctor
questions.hint: 医 (yī) is the character in 医生 (yīshēng), doctor

questions.text: Give the pinyin for the Chinese word meaning 'cold' (weather, one syllable).
questions.solution: 冷 (lěng) = cold; 热 (rè) = hot
questions.hint: It starts with l-

questions.text: What does 左 (zuǒ) mean? Choose the correct translation.
questions.solution: 左 (zuǒ) = left; 右 (yòu) = right
questions.hint: Its opposite is 右 (yòu)

questions.text: Which word means 'hotel'?
questions.solution: 酒店 (jiǔdiàn) = hotel; 商店 (shāngdiàn) = shop; 书店 (shūdiàn) = bookshop; 银行 (yínháng) = bank
questions.hint: You sleep there on holiday

questions.text: What does 右 (yòu) mean in directions? Answer in English.
questions.solution: 右 (yòu) = right; 左 (zuǒ) = left
questions.hint: 左 (zuǒ) means 'left'; this word is its opposite

questions.text: What does 天气很热 (tiānqì hěn rè) mean?
questions.solution: 天气 (tiānqì) = weather; 热 (rè) = hot
questions.hint: 热 (rè) has the 'fire' dots at the bottom

questions.text: What does 公园 (gōngyuán) mean? Choose the correct translation.
questions.solution: 公园 (gōngyuán) = park; 动物园 (dòngwùyuán) = zoo
questions.hint: 公 (gōng) means 'public' and 园 (yuán) means 'garden'

questions.text: Which word means 'bus'?
questions.solution: 公共汽车 (gōnggòng qìchē) = bus; 出租车 (chūzūchē) = taxi; 自行车 (zìxíngchē) = bicycle; 地铁 (dìtiě) = underground
questions.hint: 公共 (gōnggòng) means 'public'

questions.text: What does 我坐飞机去上海 (Wǒ zuò fēijī qù Shànghǎi) mean?

options: I go to Shanghai by plane
I go to Shanghai by train

questions.solution: 坐飞机 (zuò fēijī) = by plane; 去上海 (qù Shànghǎi) = go to Shanghai
questions.hint: 坐 (zuò) + vehicle shows how you travel

questions.text: What does 银行在学校旁边 (Yínháng zài xuéxiào pángbiān) mean?

options: The bank is behind the school
The school is in the bank
The bank is beside the school
The bank is opposite the school

questions.solution: 旁边 (pángbiān) = beside; 银行 (yínháng) = bank
questions.hint: 旁边 (pángbiān) means 'at the side'

questions.text: 我家附近有一个超市 (Wǒ jiā fùjìn yǒu yí ge chāoshì). What is near the person's home? Answer in English.
questions.solution: 超市 (chāoshì) = supermarket; 附近 (fùjìn) = nearby
questions.hint: 超 (chāo) means 'super' and 市 (shì) means 'market'

questions.text: What does 一直往前走 (yìzhí wǎng qián zǒu) mean?
questions.solution: 一直 (yìzhí) = straight; 往前 (wǎng qián) = forward; 走 (zǒu) = walk
questions.hint: 前 (qián) means 'front'

questions.text: 这件衣服多少钱 (Zhè jiàn yīfu duōshao qián)? What is the person asking? Answer in English.
questions.solution: 多少钱 (duōshao qián) = how much (money); 衣服 (yīfu) = clothes
questions.hint: 钱 (qián) means 'money'

questions.text: What does 明天会下雪 (Míngtiān huì xià xuě) mean?
questions.solution: 明天 (míngtiān) = tomorrow; 会 (huì) = will; 下雪 (xià xuě) = to snow
questions.hint: 雪 (xuě) means 'snow' and 雨 (yǔ) means 'rain'

questions.text: Read: 去年暑假我和家人去了西安，参观了兵马俑。 What did they visit?
questions.solution: 兵马俑 = the Terracotta Army (soldier and horse figures) in Xi'an
questions.hint: 兵 means 'soldier' and 马 means 'horse'

questions.text: Read: 我住的城市很漂亮，但是交通很拥挤。 What is the problem with the city?
questions.solution: 交通很拥挤 = the traffic is very congested
questions.hint: The problem comes after 但是 (but); 交通 means 'traffic'

questions.text: Read: 我们坐了十个小时的火车。 How long was the train journey?
questions.solution: 十个小时 = ten hours
questions.hint: 小时 means 'hour'; look at the number before it

questions.text: Read: 为了保护环境，我们应该多坐公共汽车，少开车。 What does the writer suggest?

options: Take the bus more and drive less
Drive more and take the bus less

questions.solution: 多坐公共汽车 = take the bus more; 少开车 = drive less
questions.hint: 多 means 'more' and 少 means 'less'

questions.text: Read: 我在商店买了一双鞋。 What did the person buy? Answer in English.
questions.solution: 一双鞋 = a pair of shoes (双 is the measure word for pairs)
questions.hint: 双 is the measure word for pairs

questions.text: Read: 我的房间不大，但是很干净。 What is the room like?
questions.solution: 不大 = not big; 很干净 = very clean
questions.hint: 干净 means 'clean'

questions.text: Read: 虽然坐火车比坐飞机慢，可是我觉得坐火车更舒服。 Which statement is accurate?

options: The train is faster and more comfortable
The train is slower but more comfortable
The plane is slower than the train

questions.solution: 比坐飞机慢 = slower than flying; 更舒服 = more comfortable
questions.hint: 慢 means 'slow' and 舒服 means 'comfortable'

questions.text: Read: 现在很多城市的空气污染很严重，所以人们要多种树。 What solution is suggested?
questions.solution: 空气污染 = air pollution; 多种树 = plant more trees
questions.hint: 种 means 'to plant' and 树 means 'tree'

questions.text: Read: 如果我有钱，我就去世界各地旅游。 What does this mean?

options: If I had money, I would travel around the world
I have money, so I travel
I travelled around the world last year

questions.solution: 如果 … 就 … = if … then …; 世界各地 = all over the world; 旅游 = travel
questions.hint: 如果 means 'if'

questions.text: Read: 从这儿到火车站要走二十分钟。 How many minutes does it take to walk to the station? Answer with a number.
questions.solution: 二十分钟 = twenty minutes
questions.hint: 分钟 means 'minute'; 二十 is two tens

questions.text: Give the pinyin for 火车站 (railway station).
questions.solution: 火车站 (huǒchēzhàn) = railway station
questions.hint: It has three syllables; 站 means 'station' or 'stop'

questions.text: Read: 那家饭馆的菜又便宜又好吃。 What is the food at that restaurant like? Answer in English.
questions.solution: 又 … 又 … = both … and …; 便宜 = cheap; 好吃 = tasty
questions.hint: 又 … 又 … links two qualities
